_schema.name: Deterministic per-subsection paragraph + proposition verification ledger
_schema.one_file_per_subsection: section2.1_paragraph_ledger.json is THIS file (subsection 2.1). 2.2-2.5 get parallel files of the same schema, created one subsection at a time.
_schema.shape: paragraphs = fields (keyed P1..Pn). Each paragraph field has subfields: plan (intent/serves/boundary/thin_claim/guardrails) + propositions[] + prose_gate + final_prose.
_schema.the_gate_rule: final_prose stays EMPTY and prose_status = BLOCKED until EVERY proposition in that paragraph has verdict in {SUPPORTED} (or is explicitly downgraded AND user-approved). Only then write prose; show user (RULE 2); on approval write into thesis_draft.tex.
_schema.evidence_rule: The ONLY admissible evidence is VERBATIM cited_text recorded in proposition.verification.evidence[]. The model's prose ANSWER is recorded in answer_nonevidence for context but is NEVER admissible (E3.5).
workflow_loop_per_paragraph: 1. Lock the paragraph's propositions (statement + source + type).
2. For each external-NLM prop: run ONE atomized non-leading query (E3-E6) -> record verbatim cited_text -> set verdict.
3. For each legal-primary prop: fetch the OFFICIAL legal text (context-mode fetch, not raw WebFetch) -> record verbatim quote + exact reference -> set verdict.
4. When all verdicts SUPPORTED -> prose_gate.unlocked = true.
5. Draft final_prose to the thin-claim ceiling; show user (RULE 2).
6. On approval: prose_status = COMMITTED; write into thesis_draft.tex 2.1; advance current_paragraph.

title: Conceptual Framework + Main Literature Review (fused)

hard_rules: ONE PARAGRAPH AT A TIME. Do not batch.
RULE 1 verify-first: no prose until every proposition is verified + recorded VERBATIM.
RULE 2 show-first: show each drafted paragraph to the user before it enters thesis_draft.tex.
NLM is the SOLE authority for the uploaded finance PAPERS -- never read a paper PDF directly.
Legal carve-out: legal-primary propositions are NOT in NLM; verify against the OFFICIAL legal text via context-mode fetch. Same integrity bar, different channel.
Numbers never typed from memory; author names never expanded from memory.
_governing.claim_ceiling: ONE signal, TWO dimensions: anticipatory (timing) x cash-concentrated (cash not stock). Both supported. WHAT solid; WHY (mechanism: compliance-constrained vs strategic silence) OPEN. Correlational, no identification. The formal cash-stock test (0.0983**, two-tailed p=.039) is VALID at 5% -- keep cash CENTRAL, do NOT demote it. (claim_findings_ledger.json)

E3_five: 3 non-leading exploratory ('what does it say about X?', NEVER 'confirm X')
5 incremental JSON; verbatim cited_text is the ONLY admissible evidence
E4_absolute: NLM is sole paper authority -- never read a PDF
ATOMIC -- one checkable proposition per query
nlm_rules_E3_E6.E5: every query lives in a committed script; paper title is the anchor.
nlm_rules_E3_E6.E6_naming: name the paper (exact title + authors + year); confirm every cited source_id is the SAME single paper.
nlm_rules_E3_E6.fan_rule: verify each DISTINCT paper-fact ONCE; fan the verdict across all instances.

_plan.section_job: 2.1 = the main, COMPLETE literature review AND the conceptual framework, fused. Situates the paper in every body of work it draws on AND derives the two dimensions. 2.2-2.5 carry only their own instrumental cites.
_plan.spine: P1 bind + P2 readable -> P3 anticipatory uncertainty trace -> P4 located in the call-varying residual; P5 cash design-contrast -> concentration + two clocks. P6 novelty, P7 scope frame it. Conclusion: an anticipatory x cash-concentrated component of CEO Q&A uncertainty, in the call-varying residual, tracking the deal's disclosure state -- a PATTERN, not a mechanism. Yields H1/H1a/H1b.

logic_chain_validated.advisor_verdict_2026_06_12: VALID and INTACT -- proceed. Guardrails folded into P1/P3/P4/P5/P6.
logic_chain_validated.A1_sign: P3: the bind must RAISE uncertainty words, not lower them. A more guarded/scripted CEO would push the measure DOWN. Earn UP affirmatively: live Q&A, analyst follow-ups, sustained clean deflection is hard -> hedging leaks. H1 one-tailed -> sign cannot be assumed.
logic_chain_validated.A2_contrast: P5: do NOT assert a cash-sharpens-the-bind mechanism (= the ruled-out scrutiny channel). Cash is a DESIGN CONTRAST (stock = same gag minus visible cash); concentration informative on its own; WHY open (P7).
logic_chain_validated.trap: P5 must never read as 'visible cash -> analysts ask more -> CEO hedges' (contradicts 4.1).
logic_chain_validated.mechanical_leg: H1b cash-persists-to-completion is MECHANICAL (cash leaves when paid); H1b CONTENT is the CONTRAST (uncertainty resolves, cash does not).
logic_chain_validated.novelty_caveat: P6 gap claim NOT NLM-verifiable (cannot prove a negative) -> 'to our knowledge'. Most likely to need walking back (everhart/gokkaya scar).
logic_chain_validated.P4_necessity: P4 is NECESSARY (signal must be in the residual), NOT sufficiency (residual does not ISOLATE the signal -- the P5 placebo + timing design do).
logic_chain_validated.P1_legal_accuracy_2026_06_12: Reg FD REJECTED as the disclosure-constraint cite (it governs SELECTIVE disclosure; a public-call disclosure SATISFIES it -> not a gag). Correct framing: deal is MATERIAL (Basic) + nonpublic; firm may stay silent but may not MISLEAD once it speaks (Basic facts = false denials -> liability; Rule 10b-5 half-truth). This bridges to P3 deflection AND keeps can't-speak/won't-speak OPEN for P7. Scope materiality to the ACQUIRER.

reg_fd_REJECTED.status: REJECTED for the disclosure-constraint claim (do NOT reintroduce).
reg_fd_REJECTED.reason: Reg FD prohibits SELECTIVE disclosure (tell one analyst -> must tell all). A disclosure on a PUBLIC earnings call SATISFIES Reg FD; it is not a gag. Reg FD cannot support 'the CEO is barred from disclosing on the call'. (advisor 2026-06-12)

P1.lit_body: disclosure-withholding theory + the MNPI/materiality legal setting
P1.intent: A firm privately committed to an acquisition but not yet announcing sits in a distinct DISCLOSURE STATE, not a balance-sheet state: the pending deal is material nonpublic information, yet the quarterly call -- especially unscripted Q&A -- is a standing obligation. The firm may stay silent but, once it speaks, may not mislead; so the CEO must host the call while unable to address the one material thing and unable to deny it. Disclosure theory frames a withholding state as informative; that bind is the paper's organizing primitive.
P1.serves: Installs 'disclosure state' as the lens; grounds it in disclosure theory + the legal setting; sets up the venue (P2) and the mechanism (P3).
P1.boundary: No mechanism yet (the deflection->hedging consequence is P3). No cash yet (P5). Do not define the measure (2.3).
P1.thin_claim: State the descriptive/correlational posture near the open. Materiality scoped to the acquirer (Basic = 'can be material', NOT 'every deal is MNPI').
guardrails: Do NOT assert a legal GAG. Frame: material (Basic) + nonpublic + may-stay-silent-but-not-mislead (Basic/10b-5). Keeps compliance-vs-strategic OPEN for P7.
Scope materiality to the ACQUIRER; a small bolt-on may be immaterial to a large acquirer.
Theory (Verrecchia/Dye) is the LENS that withholding states are informative; the legal cites establish THIS firm is in such a state. Do not conflate voluntary (theory) with compelled (legal).

propositions.statement: An informed manager may rationally choose NOT to disclose private information when disclosure is costly -- there is a threshold below which the informed manager withholds.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Establishes withholding as a rational, modeled equilibrium (not mere non-compliance) -> licenses reading a withholding state as economically meaningful.
propositions.nlm_query_draft: Reading only this paper, under what conditions does it conclude a manager who possesses private information will choose not to disclose it?

propositions.statement: Non-disclosure can persist in equilibrium because outside investors cannot always distinguish a manager who is uninformed from one who is informed but withholding.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Second, distinct theoretical foundation of withholding (the unraveling failure) -> silence is not self-revealing; a withholding state can be sustained and is informative.
propositions.nlm_query_draft: Reading only this paper, what does it conclude about the conditions under which a manager withholds information rather than disclosing it, and what role the possibility that the manager is uninformed plays?

propositions.statement: Information about preliminary/pending merger negotiations can be material to investors before a definitive agreement exists; materiality turns on a probability-times-magnitude assessment, not a bright line.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Establishes that the pending (undisclosed) deal is MATERIAL -> combined with 'nonpublic' (definitional) it is MNPI. Anchors the disclosure-state premise in law.
propositions.fetch_target: Official Supreme Court opinion text (context-mode fetch). Confirm the probability/magnitude materiality holding for merger negotiations verbatim.

propositions.statement: A firm has no general affirmative duty to disclose confidential merger negotiations (silence is permitted), but once it speaks it may not mislead -- an untrue or half-true statement is unlawful. So denial is not a lawful option, leaving deflection.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Completes the BIND: explains why the CEO cannot simply deny and move on. The deflection->hedging CONSEQUENCE is developed in P3 (handoff).

source.ref: Basic Inc. v. Levinson, 485 U.S. 224 (1988) ('silence, absent a duty to disclose, is not misleading'); Rule 10b-5, 17 C.F.R. §240.10b-5

propositions.fetch_target: Basic opinion (the silence quote + that false denials were actionable) + 17 C.F.R. §240.10b-5 text (the omission/half-truth clause). context-mode fetch.

verification.note: This is the SEAM to P3; keep the linguistic consequence out of P1.

P2.lit_body: earnings calls as a disclosure venue + textual analysis of call language
P2.intent: The earnings call is where the bind becomes legible: a recurring, semi-spontaneous event whose unscripted Q&A is far less managed than prepared remarks, and a large literature shows call LANGUAGE carries information beyond the numbers. Reading it quantitatively -- word-classification dictionaries, the presentation/Q&A split -- is an established method this paper adopts and extends to a dimension prior work has not read: uncertainty.
P2.serves: Situates the measurement venue + call-textual-analysis literature; establishes unscripted call language is informative; names the presentation/Q&A split the design rests on.
P2.boundary: Do not construct the residual (2.3). Venue + reading-method + informativeness only.
P2.thin_claim: Adopt-and-extend; no claim prior measures captured uncertainty.

propositions.statement: The unscripted Q&A portion of conference calls is less managed/scripted than prepared remarks and carries incremental information.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Licenses reading Q&A language as a signal.

propositions.statement: Word-classification dictionaries built for financial text measure tone/uncertainty, and these linguistic features are informative.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Licenses the dictionary method for the uncertainty read.

propositions.statement: Linguistic features of disclosure (e.g., complexity/readability) carry information beyond the numbers.

P3.lit_body: the mechanism -> ANTICIPATORY dimension (incl. strategic silence)
P3.intent: Under the bind, the CEO cannot answer the forbidden question directly, so unscripted answers turn hedged, qualified, non-committal -- uncertainty language rises in the Q&A. Keyed to the undisclosed state, the rise is present while the deal is secret and resolves once announcement makes it public (the information clock).
P3.serves: Derives the ANTICIPATORY dimension (timing -> H1, H1b); justifies reading uncertainty WORDS not silence.
P3.boundary: Conceptual signal only; the residual measure is 2.3.
P3.thin_claim: A pattern keyed to the disclosure state -- no causal claim about CEO intent.
guardrails: ADVISOR_FIX_sign: earn the DIRECTION (UP). A gagged CEO could go more guarded -> measure DOWN. Affirmative reason for UP: live Q&A, analysts follow up, sustained clean deflection is hard -> hedging leaks. H1 one-tailed.

propositions.statement: Managers make strategic disclosure/silence choices during conference calls, and non-answers / silence are themselves informative to the market.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Grounds the deflection mechanism in the call-silence literature.

P4.lit_body: managerial style / manager fixed effects -> why the signal is the call-varying component
P4.intent: Call-language uncertainty is partly a CEO's persistent style: managers differ durably in how they speak, and style is a fixed trait, not an anticipatory signal. An anticipatory, deal-tracking component must appear and disappear within one executive's tenure -> it can only live in the call-VARYING part, once persistent style is netted out. This is why the paper works with a within-CEO, call-level component.
P4.serves: Reviews managerial-style literature; makes the conceptual case the signal must be the call-varying component (what 2.3's residual operationalizes).
P4.boundary: CONCEPTUAL only -- do NOT write eq-4 or list first-stage regressors (2.3).
P4.thin_claim: States the locating logic; construction + caveats (generated regressand, UncPre) are 2.3.
guardrails: ADVISOR_FIX_necessity: NECESSARY-condition only -- the signal MUST be in the residual. Do NOT drift to 'the residual IS the deal signal'; the P5 placebo + timing design isolate it.

propositions.statement: Managers have persistent, individual styles that load as manager fixed effects in firm policies/outcomes -- a measurable, durable manager-specific component.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Grounds 'persistent style must be netted out'.

P5.lit_body: corporate cash holdings + cash-for-acquisitions -> CASH-CONCENTRATED dimension
P5.intent: Cash and stock deals differ in one design-relevant way: a cash purchase requires an accumulated, visible balance-sheet position -- a war chest -- while a stock deal carries the identical disclosure setting with no comparable visible cash commitment. That makes stock the placebo and a cash-CONCENTRATED signal informative on its own; WHY cash differs is left open. The two clocks then diverge: uncertainty tracks the information and resolves at announcement, while the cash position serves the purchase and -- mechanically -- persists until paid at completion.
P5.serves: Reviews cash-holdings literature; sets up CASH as a DESIGN CONTRAST (-> H1a) + the stock placebo (-> MA3); frames differential-timing CONTRAST (-> H1b), cash-persistence leg labeled mechanical.
P5.boundary: Do NOT assert 'cash sharpens the bind / visible cash invites the question' -- that IS the scrutiny channel 4.1 rules out. DESIGN CONTRAST only. Concentration, NOT strict specificity. Keep cash CENTRAL.
P5.thin_claim: A where-it-appears CONTRAST; the why stays open; the cash-persistence leg is mechanical.
guardrails: ADVISOR_FIX_contrast (A2): stock = same setting minus visible cash. Mechanism OPEN (P7).

propositions.statement: Firms accumulate cash reserves ahead of acquisitions, and cash-rich firms are more acquisitive -- a cash purchase reflects an accumulated balance-sheet position.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Grounds the 'visible accumulated cash position' that distinguishes cash from stock deals.

propositions.statement: Corporate cash holdings are large, observable, and a focus of investor/analyst attention.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Optional reinforcement of cash visibility; use only if needed.

source.ref: Bates, Kahle & Stulz (2009); Opler et al. (1999) -- NOT uploaded

P6.lit_body: the nearest work: M&A-disclosure language + pre-announcement leakage (the gap / 2x2)
P6.intent: The nearest work reads how corporate language around deals is MANAGED -- tone of prepared press releases before stock-for-stock deals, volume of strategy vocabulary on calls -- and adjacent work studies guidance and the information in disclosed acquisition plans; a separate literature documents pre-announcement leakage on the price side. What none reads is UNMANAGED language along an uncertainty dimension, before a cash deal, in the anticipatory window. That empty cell is where this paper sits.
P6.serves: Comprehensive positioning / 2x2 + the gap; the contribution's foundation.
P6.boundary: Do NOT restate the intro 2x2 verbatim; develop it. Per-hypothesis contrast stays in 2.2. No new results.
P6.thin_claim: 'We read what unmanaged language discloses' is a framing/positioning claim, not a tested mechanism.
guardrails: ADVISOR_FIX_novelty: the GAP claim ('no prior work reads this') is NOT NLM-verifiable -> 'to our knowledge', full stop. Only PER-PAPER claims run through NLM.

propositions.statement: Thewissen et al. (2024) study tone management in earnings press releases before stock-for-stock acquisitions.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Nearest-work cell: managed tone, stock deals, press releases.

propositions.statement: Ragozzino & Reuer (2024) study strategy-vocabulary volume on calls around deal activity.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Nearest-work cell: managed strategy vocabulary on calls.

propositions.statement: Everhart et al. (2025) examine M&A/acquirer guidance; Gokkaya et al. (2025) examine information in disclosed acquisition plans.
Pre-announcement information leakage shows up on the price side before M&A announcements.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Distinguishes our LANGUAGE signal from the known PRICE run-up.

propositions.statement: To our knowledge, no prior work reads unmanaged uncertainty language before cash deals in the anticipatory window.

prose_gate.rule: per-paper props SUPPORTED; gap prop stays 'to our knowledge'

P7.intent: Two readings of the prediction -- compliance-constrained disclosure (the CEO legally cannot speak) and strategic silence (the CEO chooses not to) -- are observationally equivalent in our data; we do not separate them, and the framework does not require it. We document a pattern keyed to the disclosure state, claim no identification, and leave the mechanism open.
P7.serves: Sets the honest, bounded scope; closes the framework; hands the descriptive register to 2.2.
P7.boundary: No new literature; no mechanism claim. The bounded-theory anchor for the whole section.
P7.thin_claim: Observational equivalence + no-identification stated plainly. Guarantees the review does not inflate the claim.

prose_gate.rule: no external props; gate trivially open once P1-P6 done
